text: Questions 32 through 34 refer to the following conversation.
Good morning. We still need to get our booth ready for the trade show and it opens tomorrow morning.
I know. I've already packed the brochures and the display table is set up in the corner.
Great. But the banner we ordered just arrived and it's the wrong size. It's far too small for our booth.
Hmm. I can call the supplier right now and ask them to reprint it overnight.
That would be perfect. I have to go to a meeting with the sales team in a few minutes, so could you handle that?
Of course. I'll contact them and make sure the new banner is ready by this afternoon.
